### 1 — Scene
A tray meal with baked filled pasta, likely cannelloni with meat/tomato sauce and cheese, mixed cooked vegetables, and a green salad. I include all three fully visible dishes on the tray; water is excluded.

### 2 — Vessels
Estimated diameters and areas:
- Main plate: **24 cm**, area **452 cm²**
- Vegetable bowl: **20 cm**, area **314 cm²**
- Salad plate: **20 cm**, area **314 cm²**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are filled pasta tubes, a browned sauce/cheese topping, carrots, broccoli, sweetcorn, leafy greens, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes. No separate oil or salad dressing is clearly identifiable.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Vegetables are grouped where their individual proportions are difficult to distinguish. Area percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Sauce coverage represents its exposed footprint, without counting underlying pasta twice.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |

| Sauce and browned cheese topping | 12% | 54 × 0.7 = 38 ml | 1.0 | 38 g | 160 | 61 kcal |
| Cooked carrots, broccoli, sweetcorn | 50% | 157 × 1.7 = 267 ml | 0.65 | 173 g | 50 | 87 kcal |
| Salad leaves | 55% | 173 × 2.5 = 432 ml | 0.12 | 52 g | 20 | 10 kcal |
| Cucumber and cherry tomatoes | 20% | 63 × 1.5 = 94 ml | 0.6 | 57 g | 18 | 10 kcal |

Coverage totals: **60% of the main plate, 50% of the vegetable bowl, and 75% of the salad plate**.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **650 g and 715 kcal** is plausible for the visible tray: about 370 g of baked pasta and topping, 175 g of cooked vegetables, and 110 g of salad. The largest uncertainty is the pasta filling and richness of its sauce.
